title: cypselocarpus haloragoides
intro: Cypselocarpus haloragoides, commonly known as water stork's bill or swamp water stork's bill, is a plant species within the family Haloragaceae. It is native to Australia and New Zealand, and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Bioactive constituents found in Cypselocarpus haloragoides include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
